test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She was a ________, ________ __________astronaut.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. smart, tall, Indian .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes the qualities of the astronaut in a logical and natural order.
 
• In English, adjectives are typically placed in the following order: **opinion (smart)**, **size (tall)**, and **nationality (Indian)**.
 
• Option 1 ("smart, tall, Indian") follows this standard adjective order, making it the most appropriate choice.

Correct sentence: *She was a **smart, tall, Indian** astronaut*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adjective Order in English:**

 
 
• 1. Opinion (e.g., smart, beautiful, brave)
 
• 2. Size (e.g., tall, short, big)
 
• 3. Age (e.g., young, old, new)
 
• 4. Shape (e.g., round, square, long)
 
• 5. Color (e.g., red, blue, green)
 
• 6. Origin/Nationality (e.g., Indian, American, French)
 
• 7. Material (e.g., wooden, metal, plastic)
